important.trigger: A file has one exact public identifier and earlier declarations containing lowercase/substring variants. File-level precision leaks into per-unit casefold/substring matching; max_units=1 can drop the exact declaration.
important.required_fix: Keep case-sensitive token matching through expansion, unit admission, labeling and gap binding.
